preserved_fields: Every original field, record ID, publication date, timestamp, source ID and original URL preserved; only like_count, likes_captured_at and likes_source added.
unavailable_policy: Unknown, missing, rounded-only, inaccessible or author/ID-mismatched counts are null, never fabricated as zero.
text_policy: No scraped bodies, translations, media or third-party summaries added to the post corpus.

source_fields: musk_quote_tweets.csv: musk_tweet_id + musk_quote_like_count (missing primary IDs only)
source.priority: Primary all_musk_posts count retained on conflicts; never select maximum or quoted author likes.
source.precision: exact integer as published by dataset; historical snapshot, not a current platform measurement

limitation: Counts are from the existing dataset version updated 2025-04-13. likes_captured_at denotes its snapshot date; exact original measurement times were not supplied. They must not be presented as live/current counts.
